name: Ricardo Alvarez
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. A chance encounter with a racing team during his apprenticeship as a panel beater ignited a passion that would define his career. He quickly realized the importance of a flawless paint job, not just for aesthetics but also for aerodynamics and brand image. Over the years, he has honed his skills, mastering techniques from traditional spray painting to modern ceramic coatings. 

Ricardo approaches his work with a relentless pursuit of perfection. He is known for his meticulous attention to detail, ensuring every surface is flawless before it leaves his shop. He believes in staying ahead of the curve, constantly researching new materials and application methods. While he can be demanding, particularly regarding quality standards, he is also deeply committed to his team and takes pride in mentoring younger technicians.

What sets Ricardo apart is his understanding of the interplay between aesthetics and performance. He doesn't just paint cars; he sculpts them with color, maximizing their visual impact and aerodynamic efficiency.

physical.description: Ricardo is a stocky man with strong hands and a weathered face that tells a story of years spent working with machinery.

quirks: Always uses a specific brand of imported wax on his own tools.
Insists on listening to tango music while working.
Has a lucky charm (a small, worn paint sample) that he keeps in his pocket.
